title: Create preventive.py — pure functions for pre-write ghost diff checking
acceptance_criteria: Each warning dict has: decision_id, decision_text, severity, matched_keywords, recommendation
Empty diff returns Ok([]) — no error
Empty decisions list returns Ok([]) — no error
Malformed diff text returns Ok([]) with no crash (graceful degradation)
Functions are pure: no I/O, no side effects, same input = same output
